title: Run combination-v1 coder-alone vs coder-reviewer for mac-only and mac-coder-mini-auditor
goal: Both placements have combination-v1 results for coder-alone and coder-reviewer under one totalBudget
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures and the gauntlet packs only; local models on the enrolled NERV-01 and NERV-02 over Tailscale; 0 paid cloud tokens; raw reports stay in ~/.nerv-private on their base; NERV-01's live service (~/.nerv-app, ~/.nerv) is never stopped, updated or edited.
acceptance: combination-v1, 8 cases × repeat 3 per mode, coder-alone and coder-reviewer under the same totalBudget (6144 output tokens, 360 s suite, 30 s case) with the protected grader
Run for mac-only and for mac-coder-mini-auditor (coder on NERV-01, auditor on NERV-02)
Pass rate, false rejections, missed flaws and shared blind spots recorded per mode and placement
validation: Recorded evidence for this slice; scoped checks and required CI
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
A stop rule of the placement campaign aborts the run without fallback or retry
Anything that needs a credential, an unreachable host or the owner goes back to the owner; NERV-02 is left running

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 (F-006-T22): 96 bounded combination runs over two placements; cross-node auditor wiring may need a bounded harness adapter. Implemented 2026-11-24 in 1.0 h: combination-v1 under one totalBudget: mac-only coder-alone 9/24, coder-reviewer 15/24 (3 false rejections); mac-coder-mini-auditor coder-alone 9/24, coder-reviewer 11/24 (4 false rejections, 3 missed flaws).
